summary: A member checks whether a biometric reader is separate or bundled into a commonly replaced part.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025), section 3. Washington allowed manufacturers to pair a separate biometric authentication component. A reader bundled with a commonly replaced component such as a screen falls outside that exception.
inGame: needs: a covered product's authentication component is at issue.
gates: A covered product's authentication component is at issue.
Both first manufacture and first sale or use in the state fall after the pairing rule’s cutoff.

turns.what: The reader can be replaced separately.
turns.writesBack: Staff evaluate it under the authentication exception.

turns.what: The screen and reader come as a unit.
turns.pulledBy: The reader comes attached to the replacement screen.
turns.writesBack: The stand-alone exception cannot settle the repair.
